definitions.explanation: Acting or thinking with careful consideration to avoid risks or mistakes.

examples.japanese: {決定|けってい}は{慎重|しんちょう}に{行|おこな}うべきだ。
{彼|かれ}は{慎重|しんちょう}な{性格|せいかく}だ。
{慎重|しんちょう}に{考|かんが}えてから{返事|へんじ}します。
examples.english: I will think carefully before answering.

notes:
{慎重|しんちょう} implies being careful to avoid mistakes or problems.

FORMS:
- {慎重|しんちょう}な + noun (careful ~)
- {慎重|しんちょう}に + verb (carefully)
- {慎重|しんちょう}さ (carefulness - noun form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {慎重|しんちょう}な{態度|たいど} (careful attitude)
- {慎重|しんちょう}に{検討|けんとう}する (to consider carefully)
- {慎重|しんちょう}を{期|き}す (to be very careful)

COMPARISON:
- {慎重|しんちょう}: careful, cautious (avoiding risks)
- {注意深|ちゅういぶか}い: attentive, watchful
- {丁寧|ていねい}: careful, polite (in manner)

HOMOPHONE:
{慎重|しんちょう} (careful) vs {身長|しんちょう} (height) - same reading, different meaning.
